data.name: Fatlahah
data.gender_notes: Fatlahah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ftl', meaning 'to open, to win, to achieve success'. In Islamic tradition, Fatlahah is a name given to girls symbolizing their parents' hope for their success and victory in life. The name Fatlahah carries the meaning “Victory, Success” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fatlahah usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, success and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Fatlahah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory, Success.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatlahah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: فَتْلَحَة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الفعل فتلح و يعني الفتنة و الشدة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فتلهة مشتق من الفعل فتلح، و يعني الفتنة و الشدة، و قد ورد ذكره في بعض الأحاديث النبوية، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة و الصبر في وجه الفتن

in_urdu.name: فتلحہ
in_urdu.meaning: فتنہ و شدت کا مطلب رکھتا ہے، مشتق از فتلح
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام فتلحہ عربی زبان کے فعل فتلح سے مشتق ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے فتنہ و شدت، یہ نام بعض احادیث نبوی میں ذکر پایا ہے، اور یہ ان ناموں میں سے ہے جو قوت و صبر کے معانی تحمل کرتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: फत्लह
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम फत्लह क्रिया से बना है, जिसका अर्थ है परीक्षा और कठिनाई
in_hindi.long_meaning: फत्लह नाम अरबी भाषा के क्रिया फत्लह से बना है, जिसका अर्थ है परीक्षा और कठिनाई, यह नाम कुछ हदीसों में उल्लेखित है, और यह उन नामों में से एक है जो शक्ति और धैर्य के अर्थ को धारण करते हैं

in_pashto.name: فتلحہ
in_pashto.meaning: د فتنې او سختۍ معنی لري، له فتلح څخه مشتق شوی

in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic, meaning trial, hardship, or affliction

The name carries a rich legacy of spiritual significance and cultural importance within Muslim communities worldwide
